title: Data-Driven Maintenance Optimization: Aligning Prognostic Learning with Decision Objective
abstract: arXiv:2506.19698v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Estimation error in machine learning prognostic models can propagate into poor maintenance decisions. We study a data-driven predictive maintenance problem coupling health-condition estimation with a joint ordering-replacement model. We show that the conventional Estimate-Then-Optimize (ETO) approach yields inconsistent, suboptimal decisions for a broad class of such problems. To bridge the gap, we propose an Integrated Estimate-Optimize (IEO) framework that directly targets maintenance cost as the prognostic learning objective, bypassing surrogate statistical accuracy metrics such as Kullback--Leibler divergence or mean squared error. Theoretically, we prove out-of-sample performance guarantees of the IEO framework under certain conditions, including i.i.d. and sliding-window data-generating processes. Computationally, we develop a training procedure combining Monte Carlo dropout, central-difference gradient approximation, and an ET

translated_title: 数据驱动的维护优化：将预测性学习与决策目标对齐
translated_abstract: 机器学习预测模型中的估计误差可能会传播并导致糟糕的维护决策。我们研究了一个数据驱动的预测性维护问题，该问题将健康状况估计与联合订货-更换模型相结合。我们证明，对于此类问题中广泛的一类情形，传统的“先估计后优化”方法会产生不一致且次优的决策。为了弥合这一差距，我们提出了一个“估计-优化一体化”框架，该框架直接以维护成本作为预测性学习目标，绕过了如Kullback-Leibler散度或均方误差等替代性的统计精度指标。在理论上，我们在一定条件下（包括独立同分布和滑动窗口数据生成过程）证明了IEO框架的样本外性能保证。在计算方面，我们开发了一种结合蒙特卡洛Dropout、中心差分梯度近似的训练过程以及一种ET
tldr: 提出估计-优化一体化（IEO）框架，直接以维护成本为预测学习目标进行数据驱动的维护决策优化，克服了传统先估计后优化方法的次优性问题，并提供了理论性能保证和高效训练算法。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes an Integrated Estimate-Optimize (IEO) framework that directly targets maintenance cost as the prognostic learning objective, overcoming the inconsistent and suboptimal decisions of conventional Estimate-Then-Optimize approaches, with theoretical out-of-sample performance guarantees and an efficient training procedure.
